_comment: Benign HurtLex lemmas that are legitimate in Persian credit/RAG domain. Reviewed in Phase 2 audit (30 benign texts, 7 false positives). These are NOT disabled globally; they are only allowlisted for output and for input when they appear in trusted KB context. Profanity/PII/secret remain strict.

evidence.حذف: 2 KB chunks + 2 credit phrases flagged; legitimate: 'درخواست حذف سابقه منفی قدیمی از گزارش اعتباری'
evidence.بخشی: 1 credit phrase; documented in VAST_GEMMA4_MIGRATION.md as known false positive; 'بخشی از اطلاعات'
evidence.تامین مالی: 1 credit phrase; core term 'تامین مالی از طریق تسهیلات بانکی'
evidence.اشتغال: 1 credit phrase; 'اشتغال و سابقه بیمه در امتیاز اعتباری'
evidence.پست: 1 credit phrase; 'پست سازمانی و سمت شغلی'
evidence.مصرف: 1 bench question; 'گزارش‌های مصرف را به‌صورت خودکار'
evidence.نادرست: 1 RAG answer blocked in Phase 5; legitimate: 'اطلاعات نادرست را اصلاح کنید' — common in credit report corrections
evidence.پستی: Phase 7 user sample: 'چگونه می‌توان گزارش چک را مجدداً دریافت کرد؟' blocked as hate:پستی (KB context contains پستی) — legitimate term in credit forms
evidence.مهم: KB chunk contains 'مهم است' (important) — flagged as hate:مهم for query 'جدول نوع تماس' (Type Of Contact) — legitimate, not hate
evidence.ضعیف: 6 expected answers contain 'ضعیف' (weak credit rating) — flagged as hate:ضعیف, legitimate: 'رتبه اعتباری ضعیف می‌تواند باعث رد درخواست وام شود'
evidence.خسته: v7 KB chunk for 'سلام' contains 'سلام خسته نباشید، من یه وام گرفتم...' — flagged as hate:خسته (tired), but 'خسته نباشید' is polite greeting, not hate
evidence.شرح: v7 RAG for 'دلایل کاهش امتیاز اعتباری برای مشتریان حقوقی چیست؟' blocked as hate:شرح (in generated answer or KB chunk 'شرح'), but 'شرح' means description/explanation, legitimate in credit reports
evidence.دسته: v7 RAG for 'رتبه چه فرقی با امتیاز داره؟' blocked as hate:دسته (KB chunk contains دسته‌بندی), but 'دسته' means group/category, legitimate in credit reports
evidence.جزئی: v7 RAG for 'دلایل کاهش امتیاز اعتباری برای مشتریان حقوقی چیست؟' blocked as hate:جزئی (in KB chunk or generated answer 'جزئی'), but 'جزئی' means partial/minor, legitimate in credit reports
evidence.پلیس: 120-question LLM benchmark (2026-09-09): RAG answer for 'مقایسه رقبا... پایگاه داده ملی...' blocked as hate:پلیس. Police records ('سوابق پلیس') are a legitimate credit data source in Iranian credit scoring; 'پلیس' is not hate here.
evidence.بچه: User query 'قاسم پور بچه کجاست؟' (where is he from / where is the kid) blocked as hate:بچه. بچه = kid/child, ordinary noun in birthplace and family questions.
evidence.گروه: RAG answers mentioning گروه/گروه‌بندی (e.g. credit-rating groups) blocked as hate:گروه. Core business vocabulary, not hate.
evidence.مردم: Ordinary noun 'people' — as a single-word trigger it blocks nearly every Persian sentence containing مردم. Cannot indicate hate alone.
evidence.دختر: Ordinary noun girl/daughter (bio questions, family status). Cannot indicate hate alone.
evidence.خانم: Ordinary title Ms./lady. Cannot indicate hate alone.
evidence.پوست: Ordinary noun skin (identity/appearance contexts). Cannot indicate hate alone.
evidence.قوم: Plain noun ethnicity/tribe in benign questions. Single-word matching cannot see targeting context; genuine ethno-hate needs phrasal/contextual detection (future work), not a lone-noun trigger.
evidence.روستایی: Ordinary demographic adjective rural. Cannot indicate hate alone.
evidence.قشر: Ordinary socioeconomic noun stratum/class. Cannot indicate hate alone.
evidence.مادر: User query 'مادر اعتبار سنجی چطور می تونیم گزارش استعلام کنیم' blocked as hate:مادر. مادر = mother, ordinary noun (birthplace/family/company questions). Targeted abuse using مادر still triggers on the accompanying slur via profanity/HurtLex lists.

policy: For MVP, these lemmas are allowlisted for both input and output HurtLex checks when they appear as exact-word matches. Profanity, PII, secret remain strict. Input vs output policy separated: output allowlist is primary; input allowlist prevents trusted KB context from triggering false positives in guarded_completion's augmented prompt check.
